WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId, 
        r.time AS champion_time, 
        l.time AS last_driver_time
    FROM 
        results AS r
    INNER JOIN 
        lapTimes AS l 
        ON r.raceId = l.raceId 
        AND r.driverId = l.driverId
    WHERE 
        r.position = 1 
        AND l.position = r.positionOrder
        AND r.raceId IN (
            SELECT raceId 
            FROM races 
            WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
        )
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT 
        raceId, 
        champion_time, 
        last_driver_time
    FROM 
        c_cols
    WHERE 
        champion_time IS NOT NULL 
        AND last_driver_time IS NOT NULL
),
t_calculate AS (
    SELECT 
        raceId, 
        champion_time, 
        last_driver_time
    FROM 
        c_rows
),
t_fixed_times AS (
    SELECT 
        raceId, 
        champion_time, 
        last_driver_time,
        (CAST(julianday(last_driver_time) - julianday(champion_time) AS REAL) * 100) / julianday(last_driver_time) AS percentage_faster
    FROM 
        t_calculate
    WHERE 
        last_driver_time NOT LIKE ':%' 
        AND champion_time NOT LIKE ':%'
)
SELECT 
    raceId, 
    champion_time, 
    last_driver_time, 
    percentage_faster
FROM 
    t_fixed_times
WHERE 
    raceId IN (
        SELECT raceId 
        FROM races 
        WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    );

         CAST(STRFTIME('%M', last_driver_time) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
         CAST(STRFTIME('%S', last_driver_time) AS INTEGER) + 
         CAST(STRFTIME('%f', last_driver_time) AS REAL) / 1000) * 1000 AS last_driver_millis
    FROM champion_last
),
percentage_diff AS (
